methodBoundary: Five anti-cases were frozen before source lock/theory coding. This audit occurs only after 40/40 source lock, primary Pass B, independent coding and frozen replay execution; it does not mutate S1-S10/F1-F7.

cases.finding: A scientifically real transistor effect and even a credible junction device do not imply a scalable electronics platform. Materials purity, surface stability, masking/diffusion, yield and batch reproducibility become a new frontier. Physical truth is not invalidated by manufacturing failure; the claim object changes.

Population efficacy can remain valid while industrial product safety fails. The Cutter incident invalidates a manufacturing/lot-release evaluator, not the vaccine biological-effect class. Verification must bind lifecycle phase and consequence object.

A broad directional hypothesis can be worth preserving while rationally low-tractability for decades. New ocean-floor observation surfaces and magnetic/seismic predictions transform tractability without retroactively giving earlier researchers the later evidence or mechanism.

Lunar-orbit rendezvous is architecturally less direct and introduces rendezvous risk, yet can dominate direct ascent when launch mass, deadline, staged verification and recovery structure are binding. Local architectural simplicity is not whole-system simplicity.

Large sustained research expenditure and real subsystem progress do not imply a viable whole-system route. Nuclear-aircraft mass, shielding, safety and mission constraints prevent local gains from closing the operational objective; later option value does not rescue original mission success.

measurementFinding: Independent coding yields 79/120 exact agreement (65.8%) and 102/120 coarse applicability agreement (85.0%). S4 is 12/12 exact; S3/S7/S10 are 12/12 coarse. S5 remains unstable at 2/12 exact and 5/12 coarse, reinforcing its domain-specific rather than universal status.
worldModelUpdate: HD5 anti-cases again attack claim-object collapse: principle versus manufacturable platform, field efficacy versus lot safety, directional truth versus present tractability, local architectural directness versus whole-system closure, and subsystem progress versus mission viability. No adjudicated direct contradiction appears, so falsifiability pressure remains active.
